pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā dabbo mallaputto saṅghassa senāsanañca paññapeti bhattāni ca uddisati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:1.4: tena kho pana samayena saṅghassa ekaṃ cīvaraṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:1.5: atha kho saṅgho taṃ cīvaraṃ āyasmato dabbassa mallaputtassa adāsi .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:1.8: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjissantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:1.10: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjathā’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:1.13: kathaṃ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:1.16.1: “yo pana bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya yathāsanthutaṃ bhikkhū saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇāmentīti pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:2.1.8: channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ vikappanupagaṃ pacchimaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:2.1.18: upasampannassa saṅghena sammatassa senāsanapaññāpakassa vā bhattuddesakassa vā yāgubhājakassa vā phalabhājakassa vā khajjabhājakassa vā appamattakavissajjakassa vā cīvaraṃ dinne khīyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:2.2.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī cīvaraṃ dinne khīyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:2.2.2: dhammakamme vematiko cīvaraṃ dinne khīyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:2.2.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī cīvaraṃ dinne khīyati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:2.2.4: aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ dinne khīyati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc81:2.2.5: upasampannassa saṅghena asammatassa senāsanapaññāpakassa vā bhattuddesakassa vā yāgubhājakassa vā phalabhājakassa vā khajjabhājakassa vā appamattakavissajjakassa vā cīvaraṃ vā aññaṃ vā parikkhāraṃ dinne khīyati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
